description:
NextGen Supplements – Unlock Your Potential

Brand Introduction:
NextGen Supplements is a premium sports nutrition brand built for the next generation of athletes. Founded by competitive judokas, we understand what young athletes need to perform at their best. Our mission is to provide high-quality, Made in Germany supplements while inspiring the youth to push their limits.

Product Description:
We offer a range of top-tier supplements, including Whey Protein, Creatine, Pre-Workout, and Electrolytes. Our formulas are designed specifically for young athletes, avoiding excessive stimulants and unnecessary additives while delivering optimal performance and recovery support.

Unique Selling Points (USP):
✅ Made for young athletes – Tailored formulations with balanced ingredients
✅ Premium quality, Made in Germany – Strict quality control and clean nutrition
✅ Fair pricing – High-quality supplements at affordable prices
✅ More than a brand – a movement – Inspiring young athletes with our mission: UNLOCK YOUR POTENTIAL

Payment Terms:
💰 $5 commission per product sold – on ALL products!
🔄 Monthly payouts, always on time

Other Information:
Join our affiliate program and be part of a brand that resonates with young athletes. We provide high-converting marketing materials, dedicated support, and an engaged community. Start earning today!

Welcome to NextGen Supplements! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.
These terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use products or services from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, the Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified and is bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approval or Rejection of the Registration
We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration at our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons
An affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later clicks on yours, yours is the one that counts.
Affiliates may or may not be assigned one coupon code, with details and usage clarified on the Dashboard. If a customer both clicks on the affiliate link and uses the coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, you are not allowed to promote the coupon.
Affiliates may advertise the merchant’s website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, or offline classified ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and Payment
For every customer referred to make a purchase on our website, you will receive a commission calculated based on the Commission structure. The commission amount is dependent on the order value, excluding fees such as tax and shipping costs. Commissions will not be paid for purchases made by the affiliate themselves.
To receive a commission, the affiliate must specify payment details in the Settings. The payment schedule will be notified on the Affiliate Guide page.
Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. The merchant has the right to review all referral orders. The commission status is displayed in the Commission tab, and any paid commission is listed in the Payment tab. Transactions resulting in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing Tools
We may share promotional media such as banners, logos, or specific collection promotions with you through the Marketing Tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code to share on affiliate channels.

5. Network
If the Network tab is activated, affiliates can invite others to become their downline affiliates. If a downline affiliate generates an order, the upline affiliate will receive a network commission, depending on merchant settings.
To invite others into the system, share your network link. Any affiliate who clicks on the link and signs up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Cookies
We use cookies to track people who click on your link. If a person does not allow cookies or clears their cookies, we will be unable to track them, and no earnings can be paid for that person’s activity.
The duration of the cookie is specified on the Affiliate registration form. Within the cookie period, every order made by the customer at the merchant's website will result in commissions for the affiliate, regardless of whether the customer clicks on the affiliate link again.

7. No Misleading Health Claims
Affiliates must not make any statements that violate health claims regulations. Only approved and scientifically supported claims about the health benefits of the products can be used.

8. No Use of Bots
Automated tools or bots are strictly prohibited to increase traffic or manipulate performance and sales. Any violations will result in the immediate suspension of the affiliate account.

9. Transparent Communication
Affiliates must ensure that all promotional messages are clearly marked as advertising. It should be transparent that the affiliate earns a commission on sales made through their referral.

10. No Spam Practices
Affiliates must not use unsolicited emails (spam) or aggressive advertising methods to promote products. This includes the use of spam on social media platforms.

11. Compliance with Legal Regulations
Affiliates are responsible for complying with applicable legal regulations in their country, especially regarding consumer protection and advertising laws.

12. No Trademark Violations
Affiliates are only allowed to use the NextGen Supplements brand according to approved guidelines. Unauthorized use of the brand, including in URLs, social media, or advertisements, is strictly prohibited.

13. Transparent Data Processing
Affiliates must ensure they comply with all data protection laws, especially GDPR if operating within the EU.

14. Removal from the Referral Program
If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they may do so by contacting: affiliates@nextgen-supplements.com.

We wish you all the best! You can revisit these Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions at any time, and if you have any questions, please email affiliates@nextgen-supplements.com for support.
